recent_findings.evidence: Apex domain 'grofer.io' publishes NO DMARC record at _dmarc.grofer.io and NO strict SPF (-all). While the domain lacks active MX records, unauthorized outbound senders can forge From: headers to external recipients.
recent_findings.remediation: Publish a strict DMARC record at '_dmarc.grofer.io' with 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=reject;' and ensure valid SPF (~all or -all).
